statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-13505 (GHSA-98j2-6v39-78w8): in Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS, key material held by the AES and DESede engines, the SP 800-90A DRBGs, SymmetricSecretKey and the PBKD and scrypt parameter classes was zeroised on garbage collection through Object.finalize; on Java 9 and later JVMs the finalizer queue can fall behind, so key material stays in the heap and the backlog can contribute to an OutOfMemoryError. bc-fips 2.1.x before 2.1.3 is affected, and 2.1.3 fixes it by running that disposal from a java.lang.ref.Cleaner on Java 9 and later: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-98j2-6v39-78w8, https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/wiki/CVE%E2%80%902026%E2%80%9013505. The DHI eclipse-temurin-21-jre packages for Alpine 3.23 ship Bouncy Castle FIPS in their eclipse-temurin-21-jre-fips subpackage, as /usr/lib/bouncycastle/bc-fips-<version>.jar. Read the manifest of every jar in every published eclipse-temurin-21-jre-fips package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository (18 versions, 21.0.10.7-r0 to 21.0.13.9.1.2-r0; x86_64 and aarch64). The bc-fips jar is 2.1.2 in 21.0.10.7-r0 to 21.0.12.1.1-r0 and 21.0.12.8-r0, and 2.1.3 in 21.0.12.1.1-r1, and in 21.0.12.8.1.1-r2 and every later build. 21.0.12.8-r0 sorts after 21.0.12.1.1-r1 but went back to bc-fips 2.1.2, so the range closes at 21.0.12.1.1-r1, reopens at 21.0.12.8-r0 and closes again at 21.0.12.8.1.1-r2, the next build with 2.1.3.

CVE-2026-13505 (GHSA-98j2-6v39-78w8): in Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS, key material held by the AES and DESede engines, the SP 800-90A DRBGs, SymmetricSecretKey and the PBKD and scrypt parameter classes was zeroised on garbage collection through Object.finalize; on Java 9 and later JVMs the finalizer queue can fall behind, so key material stays in the heap and the backlog can contribute to an OutOfMemoryError. bc-fips 2.1.x before 2.1.3 is affected, and 2.1.3 fixes it by running that disposal from a java.lang.ref.Cleaner on Java 9 and later: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-98j2-6v39-78w8, https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/wiki/CVE%E2%80%902026%E2%80%9013505. The DHI eclipse-temurin-21-jre packages for Debian 13 ship Bouncy Castle FIPS in their eclipse-temurin-21-jre-fips subpackage, as /usr/lib/bouncycastle/bc-fips-<version>.jar. Read the manifest of every jar in every published eclipse-temurin-21-jre-fips package for Debian 13 in the DHI Debian repository (12 versions, 21.0.11.10-0 to 1:21.0.13+9-3; architecture-independent, the same file for amd64 and arm64). The bc-fips jar is 2.1.2 in 21.0.11.10-0 to 21.0.12.1.1-0 and 21.0.12.8-0, and 2.1.3 in 21.0.12.1.1-1, and in 1:21.0.12.1+1-2 and every later build. 21.0.12.8-0 sorts after 21.0.12.1.1-1 but went back to bc-fips 2.1.2, so the range closes at 21.0.12.1.1-1, reopens at 21.0.12.8-0 and closes again at 1:21.0.12.1+1-2, the next build with 2.1.3. Builds with the 1: epoch sort above every build without one.
